testResults.name: composition-integrity-fixes
testResults.result: Integration fixed six composition-blocking defects found by focused review and live-boot diagnosis: SessionJournal now persists through the SnapshotObjectStore port (RuntimeStateStore exposes no raw store surface); _compose supplies the required kill_switch; the live inboxes compose without the nonexistent clock kwarg; boot recovery wraps SnapshotBrokerStatePort in a real RuntimeReconciler; periodic reconciliation passes ReconcileTrigger.PERIODIC with a correctly advanced sequence; __all__ exports the real phase class name

testResults.name: live-deployment-fixes
testResults.result: Four live-boot defects found and fixed against the deployed dev trader: the websockets transport dependency was missing from the runtime image (SystemExit before any journal write); the deployed trader config referenced an unimplemented market-data adapter and a nonexistent strategy module (repointed to the alpaca_ws SIP feed and BuyAndHoldStrategy); _resolve_credentials keyed resolved values by config field name while checking and subscripting by environment-variable name, so every boot failed the credential gate deterministically; and the live SIP feed interleaves per-symbol timestamps, which the deterministic kernel rejects, fixed by the bounded ReorderingInbox lateness window at the supervision boundary

testResults.name: live-paper-session-and-restart-drill
testResults.command: az containerapp update fca-ml-dev-rth-trader min-replicas 1; az containerapp revision restart; supervision.json + restarts.json + snapshots from harness-state
testResults.result: The deployed supervisor ran a live paper session: 4566 market events consumed, the strategy bought 5 SPY (cash 96161.03, equity 99999.37), periodic snapshots captured, heartbeats and watermark advancing. The mid-session revision restart exercised the full recovery path: the new boot restored via resume_reconcile (action resume, snapshot 2fed09c9) with books intact. The supervision crash-loop gate had earlier engaged exactly as designed during the websockets incident and the durable restart ledger bounded it

testResults.name: live-restart-drill
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev harness trader --config config/harness/trader-crypto.yaml (paper, local filesystem store with LAKE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME unset, Alpaca credentials injected from fca-ml-dev-kv-obj3kww); hard kill via Stop-Process -Force at 2026-09-09T01:23Z; relaunch of the same command and run id trader-trader-crypto-local-2026-09-09; focused suites re-run after each drill-surfaced fix (137 passed across tests/harness/cli/test_supervisor.py, tests/harness/runtime/test_restart_cycle.py, test_state_store.py, test_recovery.py, test_paper_shell.py)
testResults.result: Continuous UTC-day crypto session drill with real Alpaca crypto data (BTC/USD). Boot 1 (2026-09-09T01:18:48Z): phase running, 329 market events, 346 dispatched, 4 periodic snapshots, BuyAndHold bought 0.01 BTC (cash 99213.30100439752). Hard kill with no graceful shutdown, then relaunch of the same run id: recovery block {policy: resume_reconcile, action: resume, snapshot eb0e34ebd739, report 0e72cc31f623}; books restored exactly (cash and the 0.01 BTC position); phase running with 180 market events and last_event_time advancing (01:27:56Z); 5 post-resume periodic snapshots (9 total, e.g. 754c8cd3e06e at 01:28:00Z); consecutive_faults 0 and restarts.json absent because no fault ever fired; stdout/stderr empty, no duplicate-fill errors. The drill surfaced and fixed four live-feed defects: commit 27ad6e4 (the Alpaca crypto default endpoint wss://stream.data.alpaca.markets/v1beta3/crypto answers HTTP 404; feeds now take a websocket_url override, set to the /us locale in trader-crypto.yaml), 4d8694d (ReorderingInbox wedged forever when a burst filled the 8192-slot buffer with stamps tighter than the 2s lateness window; the boundary now sheds the oldest buffered event instead of stalling the kernel), b83b9c2 (resumed boots lost the idle_pace housekeeping hook, freezing supervision docs and disabling heartbeats, snapshots, kill-switch polls, and market-wait; restore re-arms the pace), and dcd14d0 (restored shells lacked the session fill history, so the first post-resume capture faulted on book-referenced fill sim-fill-3; restore replays the booked fills)

limitations: AC1 (a dev paper deployment survives a mid-session container restart) is verified: the local crypto drill ran a continuous UTC-day session on real Alpaca data, hard-killed the trader mid-session, restored via resume_reconcile with books and fill history intact, and continued the session with supervision snapshots and event counts advancing. The deployed Azure RTH trader inherits the same supervision stack (trader CLI, TraderSupervisor, resume_reconcile, ReorderingInbox boundary)
The option ensure route (_ensure_option) retains its own short-circuit and is not repaired by this change
